info.title: CareerLens API
info.description: Educational CareerLens API: authentication, synthetic job catalog/private bookmarks, synthetic resume examples, and practice applications. Unsafe requests require the session cookie and X-CSRF-Token. Rules mode makes no external AI calls. Explicitly configured llm mode sends bounded resume/job/answer excerpts to the configured OpenAI model for separate coaching. No actual employer applications are sent. See docs/architecture/prompt-editing.md. Desired-role flow uses editable internal references and acknowledged resume/role/report preparation stages; it does not query or match job listings. Optional coaching receives these explicitly labeled internal references.

get.description: Public endpoint. Returns user=null for guests. Creates a signed anonymous session cookie if necessary. Provider enabled flags reflect this project configuration.

post.summary: Create an email account and sign in
post.description: An anonymous or authenticated session cookie and its CSRF token are required; call GET /auth/session first. When present, Origin must match PUBLIC_ORIGIN.

403.description: Missing/invalid CSRF token or disallowed Origin

400.description: Invalid JSON, email, name or password

429.description: Authentication attempt limit exceeded (30 requests per action and peer IP in 10 minutes)

post.description: An anonymous or authenticated session cookie and its CSRF token are required; call GET /auth/session first. When present, Origin must match PUBLIC_ORIGIN.

200.description: The same generic message is returned regardless of account existence, OAuth-only account status or delivery failure. Reset tokens are never returned in this API response.

post.description: An anonymous or authenticated session cookie and its CSRF token are required; call GET /auth/session first. When present, Origin must match PUBLIC_ORIGIN.

200.description: Password changed, all user sessions revoked, and a fresh anonymous session returned

403.description: Missing/invalid CSRF token or disallowed Origin

400.description: Invalid JSON/password or invalid, expired, already-used reset token

429.description: Authentication attempt limit exceeded (30 requests per action and peer IP in 10 minutes)

get.description: Navigate the browser to this endpoint. The signed session cookie stores OAuth state; retain it for the callback. Requires this project provider client ID/secret. No X-CSRF-Token header is used for this GET; provider state/nonce is validated on return.

302.description: Redirect to provider authorization; may set the session cookie

429.description: Authentication attempt limit exceeded (30 requests per action and peer IP in 10 minutes)

get.summary: Validate the provider callback and establish the local session
get.description: Provider-facing browser callback. Requires the cookie that initiated OAuth. Authlib validates OAuth state and, for OIDC, the signed ID token and nonce. Failure or cancellation also redirects to the frontend with an auth_error query parameter; no provider token is returned to the browser.

parameters.name: code
parameters.description: Authorization code on successful provider authorization.

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: Must match the value saved in the initiating session to complete login.

parameters.name: error
parameters.description: Provider denial/error code instead of authorization code.

302.description: Redirect to PUBLIC_ORIGIN/ after success; on failure redirect to PUBLIC_ORIGIN/?auth_error=... . Successful login rotates session and CSRF tokens.

get.summary: Browse public examples plus own private manual postings
get.description: Anonymous reads show examples only. Logged-in reads include own manual posts and bookmark status. saved=1 requires authentication. Facets include all visible postings independent of active filters. Literal case-insensitive q searches company, role, description and skills; other filters are exact, skill is case-insensitive. No external API calls.

post.description: Call resume then role then report. Successful completed stages are idempotent. Out-of-order stages return 400. Stale fingerprints or concurrent input changes return 409 preparation_stale without committing stale analysis. Report preparation produces questions and preliminary_report, not draft.report. Rules fallback after optional coaching errors is a completed local analysis, identified in report.agent.

sessionCookie.name: careerlens_session
sessionCookie.description: Signed session cookie. Auth entrypoints accept an anonymous session; workflow endpoints require a valid authenticated server session.

csrfToken.name: X-CSRF-Token
csrfToken.description: Token returned by GET /auth/session, bound to the same cookie. Replace after login, registration, logout and password reset.

answers.description: Only IDs returned by the current questions endpoint are accepted; omitted answers are empty.

csrf_token.description: Send in X-CSRF-Token on unsafe API requests. Replaced after registration, login, logout and password reset.

mail_mode.description: local writes password reset mail to the private server outbox; smtp uses configured SMTP.

token.description: Single-use reset token from the reset email; expires after 15 minutes.

PasswordResetResult.description: Anonymous session (user is null), rotated csrf_token, and completion message. Other sessions for this user are revoked.

source_url.description: Optional http(s) URL without credentials. Stored only; never fetched by this API.
Optional http(s) URL without credentials. Stored only; never fetched by this API.

JobPosting.description: Examples are fictional educational postings. Manual postings are visible only to their creator. source_url on examples identifies role inspiration, not a live opening at the fictional company.

AgentMetadata.description: Execution events, not model chain-of-thought. Default workflow is deterministic.

CatalogMatching.description: Current saved resume and optional evidence compared with all visible catalog jobs. Local rules total: job evidence70 + performed context20 + quantified outcomes10. Not hiring probability. Private postings belong only to this session user.

role.description: Required non-empty when role_id=custom; ignored for predefined roles.

focus.description: Optional user context used to tailor one follow-up question; never an invented employer requirement or direct score modifier.

Preparation.description: Actual server-completed work, bound to resume/target/reference fingerprint. Errors never mark the stage complete. No elapsed-time percentage is claimed.

fingerprint.description: Send current workspace preparation fingerprint to reject stale input.
